# Nominally bounded carrier with scalar context and checked throws

Owned static declarations retain one Number-bounded method formal through an
invariant List input and List result, with independent int and boolean inputs
and an IOException declaration. A same-owner generic overload supplies a fixed
boolean while forwarding both integers and the original list.

Five frozen entry routes compare 160 fresh JVM cases twice in source and SDK
profiles. Observers check opaque input/result identity, full integer values,
boolean forwarding, null/empty/aliased lists, callback writes and configuration,
exact checked/runtime/Error failures, the provider's original List cast and
later element reads and bound casts. Nine wrong programs and eight same-Code
Signature controls qualify the checks. Every emitted Java unit compiles with
original class/method/Code/access/Signature/Exceptions accounting.
